Had coffee with Abdelaziz Saidu this morning. He’s the General Manager for Cisco across Nigeria and Ghana, and it was refreshing being able to catch up on what is happening in the West African tech/policy space. We covered a lot of topics: digital sovereignty, local data centres, compliance frameworks, and where Nigeria and Ghana are across the board. As you can imagine, the current realities are different from what the headlines report. I learn a lot every time I get to talk with Mr Saidu. I did not realise that, often, when someone sends money in Nigeria, the transaction record does not stay in Nigeria. Instead, it sits in the cloud, on a server that is usually abroad. These Nigerian companies and fintechs simply rent the space. The Central Bank of Nigeria, in a memorandum released in June, has instructed that this must change, on or before January 2027. This new policy is much harder to implement than it sounds. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I'm thrilled to share that I've joined Cyera as Chief Marketing Officer! Every so often, a company emerges at exactly the right moment in a market, possessing the right leadership and team, the right technology, and the right ambition. Cyera is that company. AI is rewriting how every enterprise operates, and data is the fuel. But you can't transform with AI if you can't see, classify, and protect the data that powers it. That's the problem Cyera was built to solve and no one is better positioned to solve it. From the world's largest banks to leading healthcare systems and global enterprises, Cyera is becoming the trusted data security foundation for the AI era. This is a rare opportunity to do category-defining work, to build a brand that breaks through, tell a story that shapes how the industry thinks about AI and data security, and help the world's most ambitious enterprises move faster and more safely into what's next. Huge thanks to Yotam Segev, Tamar Bar-Ilan, Jason Clark, Yonatan Itai, the Cyera Board and the entire Cyera leadership team for the trust and the partnership ahead. And to the marketing team I'm inheriting - I can't wait to build with you. We're hiring across the company and in marketing. If you want to do the best work of your career on one of the most important problems in tech, let's talk. Onward. #cyera #AIsecurity #datasecurity
